# 334_R7UX.11 — dedicated marketing layout/nav (BL-89, UXC-13 remainder)

## What

The public marketing surface gets its own layout + nav per design spec §15.1, distinct
from both the app shell and the beta's flat `Shell`: a sticky `data-mk-nav` header —
`Rhēma · Product · Workflows · Demo · Pricing · Changelog · Docs · Sign in ·
[Get Rhēma free]` — over a 1120-px marketing column, plus a `data-mk-footer` that
repeats the section map ahead of the shared legal line.

The DS §15 source **exists** (`docs/rhema-design-spec.md` line ~2873), so the ticket's
structural-only fallback is not triggered; the twelve-section order already matches the
shipped landing, so this ticket is chrome + anchors + footer. **Content is moved, not
invented** — every claim keeps its existing wording (§16.4/G2 gating honored; the nav
labels are new chrome vocabulary in `COPY.landing.nav.*`).

**Nav contract:**

- Every destination is a real route or a real `id` on a rendered section — `/#dossier`
  (Product), `/#workflow` (Workflows), `/demo`, `/pricing`, `/#changelog`, `/login`,
  `/signup`; the absolute `/#` form lets the same chrome serve `/pricing` without a
  dead fragment.
- `/demo` stays a document navigation (S-14): `data-spa-native` +
  `data-demo-entry="nav"`, same as every other demo entry.
- §15.1's **Docs** has no public docs surface — it renders as a marked non-link
  placeholder `data-mk-nav-pending="docs"` (title explains), never a dead href.
  Deferred to **D-R7UX.11-1** along with the remaining copy/art.
- Signed-in `/pricing` keeps REQ-PUB-1: "Sign in" swaps for `data-pricing-app → /app`.
- All plain anchors — the nav is progressive enhancement only, no island (RV-36).
